references.text: Moses reminds the people that they were slaves in Egypt and that the Lord brought them out with a strong hand
Instructions to tell the children about the exodus from Egypt, using the same wording about a strong hand
God identifies Himself as the one who brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Repetition that the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Reminder that Israel was a slave in Egypt and that the Lord brought them out with a strong hand
The Lord brought Israel out with a strong hand and redeemed them from the house of slavery in Egypt
Confession that the Egyptians oppressed Israel, and that the Lord brought them out with a strong hand
Joshua reminds the people that the Lord brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery
Praise to God who brought Israel out of Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
